CUBIC PHASE KERNELS: A CONDITIONAL TRUSTED-CONTROL TRADEOFF
Owned closed operation and proof, 24 October 2026

Status
This is a conditional resource construction using established coherent Pauli
checks, classical syndrome codes and quadratic-form synthesis. It is not a new
error-correction architecture or a demonstrated hardware advantage. An equally
informed CPC/quantum-filter implementation can use precisely this protocol.
The independently derived resource statement compares all-trusted finite-gate
implementation with one explicitly counted noisy native kernel plus smaller
trusted control. Native hardware, time, interaction strength, dephasing and
classical compilation remain substantive resources. Priority is unestablished.

1. Problem, native resource and output

For n qubits and a known cubic polynomial over F2,

 f(x)=sum_(i<j<k) c_ijk x_i x_j x_k,      c_ijk in{0,1},
 U_f|x>=(-1)^f(x)|x>,                  M=binom(n,3),

suppose the native device implements the following concrete diagonal evolution:

 H_f=(pi hbar/tau) sum c_ijk N_i N_j N_k, N_i=(I-Z_i)/2,
 d rho/dt= -i[H_f,rho]/hbar
           +sum_i gamma_i(t)(Z_i rho Z_i-rho), 0<=t<=tau.

Coefficients, duration, Markovian independent local dephasing, supplied native
device and trusted gate-error bounds are MODEL INPUTS, not experimentally acquired
here. No arbitrary noisy non-Clifford processor is covered. The error-free kernel
is exactly U_f. All generators commute, including the superoperators, so the
actual native channel is

 N_f = Z_p o U_f,
 Z_p = tensor_i[(1-p_i)Id+p_i Ad_(Z_i)],
 p_i=(1-exp(-2 Gamma_i))/2,       Gamma_i=int_0^tau gamma_i(t)dt.       (1)

Thus local Z noise THROUGHOUT the native operation becomes the stated output
phase-flip channel by derivation. A local X fault during a cubic kernel instead
spreads into X_i times a suffix quadratic phase, generally not a Pauli. Such
faults are not covered by (1) and must not be silently replaced by outputweight1.

Desired output is the deterministic corrected channel on an ARBITRARY n-qubit
input, preserving an arbitrary external reference. No branch is postselected.
One invocation of the ordinary native N_f is used, with no controlled-U or U† call.

24 October 2026. No fresh physical-constructor science read. No method winner.

Outcome
Derived and checked a deterministic quantum recovery operation for known cubic
phase kernels with commuting local dephasing, together with a robust generic
lower bound on all-trusted implementation. The result is a CONDITIONAL trusted-
control tradeoff. It uses established coherent-check machinery; equally informed
CPC/quantum-filter methods tie the protocol. No new hardware, total-runtime,
energy or incumbent-superiority claim is established. Priority is unestablished.

Closed operation
For U_f|x>=(-1)^f(x)|x>, f cubic overF2, use r=ceil(log2(n+1)) protected syndrome
qubits. H's nonzero binary columns label each single-Z error. Output checks are
X(H_row); prechecks are U_f†X(H_row)U_f. Controlled pre/post checks around ONE
ordinary native invocation write the syndrome independently of an arbitrary
logical input/reference; feedforward Z correction retains every outcome. Any
coherent Kraus span{I,Z_i} is corrected exactly. This is ordinary syndrome
recovery expressed as a known CPC/PCS superchannel, not a new Hamming code.

Native error class is DERIVED, not replaced by one output fault
Specified native Hamiltonian H_f=(pi hbar/tau)sum c_ijk N_i N_j N_k, with local
Markovian Lindblad terms gamma_i(t)(Z_i rho Z_i-rho), commutes throughout. It
therefore implements U_f followed by independent Z flips
p_i=(1-exp(-2 int gamma_i))/2. Full residual normalized diamond error is exactly
the probability of>=2 net flips, bounded by sum_(i<j)p_i p_j. Internal X/Y or
leakage noise is not covered: an X fault generally grows a suffix quadratic phase.

Load-bearing representation and costs
The discrete derivative f(x+q)+f(x) is quadratic. Its polar form has rank2s;

uses at most n/2 CCZs, O(n²) Clifford gates, plus controlled-X and postcheck.
Total trusted control: O(n log n) CCZ-equivalents, O(n²log n) Clifford primitives,
O(log n) protected qubits, with readout/reset/feedforward and idle errors paid.

The supplied projector Hamiltonian and all local Z dephasing superoperators
commute. Integrating them therefore gives the stated independent output-Z channel
with p_i=(1-exp(-2 integral gamma_i))/2, without treating an internal arbitrary
fault as an output single-qubit Pauli. X/Y faults and leakage are outside this
derivation and must enter the separate model-deviation budget if present.

I reconstructed the control-string identity
  V_out(a)^dagger Z(e) U_f V_in(a)=(-1)^(a.H e) Z(e) U_f.
The declared precheck ordering and reverse postcheck ordering implement this
identity. Walsh readout extracts only the error syndrome, so the argument applies

readout followed by the corresponding Z correction factors the data/reference
operation as U_f; trace preservation and Pauli orthogonality give unit total
